name: codex-completion-notifier
description: Show a VS Code notification when a supported local AI agent turn ends.

scripts.package:verify: powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/verify-release-readiness.ps1 && node -e "require('node:fs').mkdirSync('release', { recursive: true })" && vsce package --allow-missing-repository --out release/local-agent-completion-notifier-0.3.0.vsix && powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/verify-vsix.ps1 release/local-agent-completion-notifier-0.3.0.vsix
